business_problem: The manufacturing sector collects the largest volume of data of any global industry each year, but it only uses a fraction of the industrial data collected in factories. Sight Machine’s Manufacturing Data Platform enables real-time, data-driven operations for global manufacturers to achieve breakthrough performance by continuously improving sustainability, resilience, and profitability.
solution_summary: Sight Machine used Azure OpenAI Service, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Azure to deliver faster, more responsive analytics from operational data. The manufacturing sector collects the largest volume of data of any global industry each year, but it only uses a fraction of the industrial data collected in factories. Sight Machine’s Manufacturing Data Platform enables real-time, data-driven operations for global manufacturers to achieve breakthrough performance by continuously improving sustainability, resilience, and profitability.
